lede: Automotive Repair Centre [Jurong] is a car workshop in Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub. Its own website lists accident claims and reporting, paint and body work, maintenance and repair and diagnostics.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention accident repair handled through the other party’s insurance, help with accident reports, clear and timely updates, and cars returned within the promised time.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, automotiverepaircentre.com.sg.
makes_note: Not listed on its public pages. Ask the workshop about your car.
